# TGAB — The Global Assets Broker

> TGAB is a pre-launch, multi-asset brokerage licensed by the Financial Services Commission, Mauritius, as an Investment Dealer (Full Service Dealer, excluding Underwriting), Licence No. GB26206568.

TGAB plans to launch with access to US equities, US-listed options, and US-listed ETFs through regulated institutional infrastructure. Futures, foreign exchange, metals and commodities, indices, fixed income, and digital assets are roadmap products. Website information is general information, not investment advice.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://tgab.com/): Company overview and launch proposition.
- [Markets](https://tgab.com/markets): Launch products, roadmap products, and market hours.
- [Platforms](https://tgab.com/platforms): Planned trading platform and client portal.
- [Pricing](https://tgab.com/pricing): Indicative pre-launch commissions and fees.
- [Security and trust](https://tgab.com/security): Client asset, account, and data protection.
- [Company](https://tgab.com/company): Corporate and regulatory overview.
- [FAQ](https://tgab.com/faq): Answers about launch, eligibility, accounts, fees, and security.
- [Legal](https://tgab.com/legal): Regulatory status, risk disclosure, terms, privacy, and complaints.
- [Contact](https://tgab.com/contact): General and partnership enquiries.
